title: Cluster Health
description: One page to debug the cluster: Talos nodes, control plane, etcd, workloads, storage, CloudNativePG, CoreDNS and the monitoring stack itself. Every stat in the top rows counts problems, so green means zero.

panels.title: Nodes not Ready
panels.description: Nodes known to kube-state-metrics minus nodes whose Ready condition is true.

panels.title: Node pressure conditions
panels.description: MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, PIDPressure or NetworkUnavailable set on any node. The kubelet evicts pods under pressure.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Firing alerts other than Watchdog and InfoInhibitor. The table below lists them.

panels.title: Scrape targets down
panels.description: Targets Prometheus failed to scrape on its last attempt (up == 0). The bottom row lists them.

panels.title: Unhealthy pods
panels.description: Pods Pending or Unknown, plus Running pods that are not Ready. Failed pods are left out: the ones a node shutdown leaves behind were already replaced, and failed Jobs show in the Workloads row.

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, pod) ((kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Unknown"} == 1) or ((kube_pod_status_ready{condition="false"} == 1) unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1)))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Container restarts across the cluster in the selected time range.

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Containers the kernel OOM-killed in the selected time range (cAdvisor's container_oom_events_total).

panels.title: Replicas unavailable
panels.description: Unavailable replicas summed over Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets. The Workloads row lists them.

targets.expr: (sum(kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable) or vector(0)) + (sum(kube_daemonset_status_number_unavailable) or vector(0)) + (sum(kube_statefulset_replicas - kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready) or vector(0))

panels.title: etcd members without leader
panels.description: Scraped etcd members minus members reporting a leader. Anything above 0 means a member is partitioned or down.

panels.title: etcd leader changes
panels.description: Leader elections in the selected time range. Frequent elections point at slow disks (fsync) or CPU steal on the VMs.

panels.title: etcd DB size
panels.description: Largest member's backend size. etcd's default quota is 2 GiB: past it the cluster turns read-only until defragmented.

panels.title: API server 5xx
panels.description: Share of API server requests answered with a 5xx over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: PVCs not Bound
panels.description: PersistentVolumeClaims stuck Pending or Lost.

panels.title: Fullest PVC
panels.description: Highest used/capacity among mounted volumes (kubelet volume stats). The Workloads row shows every PVC.

panels.title: Postgres instances down
panels.description: CNPG instances whose exporter reports the database unreachable (cnpg_collector_up == 0). A pod that is gone entirely shows under Unhealthy pods instead.

panels.title: Oldest Postgres backup
panels.description: Age of the latest barman-cloud base backup of the cluster that backed up longest ago. Backups run nightly, so past 26h one was missed.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Grouped by alert, severity and namespace; Count is how many series fire.

panels.title: Unhealthy pods
panels.description: Pods Pending or Unknown, containers waiting (CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, ContainerCreating…), and Running pods that are not Ready. Failed pods are left out (see the Unhealthy pods stat).

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod, state) (label_replace(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Unknown"} == 1, "state", "$1", "phase", "(.*)") or label_replace(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason == 1, "state", "$1", "reason", "(.*)") or label_replace(((kube_pod_status_ready{condition="false"} == 1) unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Succeeded|Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1)) unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason == 1), "state", "NotReady", "namespace", ".*"))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Kubernetes view (kube-state-metrics) and OS view (node-exporter) of each Talos node. Nodes Overview in the links above has the full node-exporter breakdown.

targets.expr: max by (node) ((node_time_seconds - node_boot_time_seconds) * on (instance) group_left (node) label_replace(node_uname_info, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))
max by (node) ((1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) * on (instance) group_left (node) label_replace(node_uname_info, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Memory usage
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal.

targets.expr: max by (node) ((1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) * on (instance) group_left (node) label_replace(node_uname_info, "node", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Pressure stall (some)
panels.description: PSI: share of time at least one task stalled on memory or IO. Sustained memory stall precedes OOM kills; IO stall usually means Longhorn or etcd disks are saturated.

panels.title: Scheduled vs allocatable
panels.description: Sum of requests (and memory limits) of the pods placed on each node, divided by what the node can allocate. Requests near 100% block scheduling; memory limits above 100% mean the node can be OOM-squeezed.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"} unless on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Succeeded|Failed"} == 1)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})

panels.title: API server p99 latency by verb
panels.description: Excludes WATCH and CONNECT, which are long-lived by design.

panels.title: Kubelet PLEG relist p99
panels.description: How long the kubelet takes to list containers from containerd. Above a few seconds the node flaps NotReady (PLEG is not healthy).

panels.title: etcd WAL fsync p99
panels.description: etcd wants this under 10ms. Slow fsync causes leader elections and API latency.

panels.title: etcd backend commit p99
panels.description: etcd wants this under 25ms.

panels.title: etcd peer round trip p99
panels.description: Network latency between etcd members, which run on VMs across both Proxmox hosts.

panels.title: etcd DB size and failed proposals
panels.description: Solid: backend size per member. Bars: failed Raft proposals per second (should stay at zero).

panels.title: Last termination reason
panels.description: Why each container last exited, for containers whose last exit was not Completed: OOMKilled means raise the memory limit, Error means read the logs.

panels.title: Workloads not at desired state
panels.description: Deployments and DaemonSets with unavailable replicas, StatefulSets with fewer ready replicas than desired, and Jobs with failed pods.

targets.expr: max by (kind, namespace, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_unavailable > 0, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.*)"), "kind", "Deployment", "namespace", ".*") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_unavailable > 0, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.*)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "namespace", ".*") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas - kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready > 0, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.*)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "namespace", ".*") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_job_status_failed > 0, "workload", "$1", "job_name", "(.*)"), "kind", "Job", "namespace", ".*"))

panels.title: PVC usage
panels.description: Used / capacity of every mounted PersistentVolumeClaim, as the kubelet sees it.

panels.title: Postgres instances
panels.description: One row per CNPG instance. WAL archived: time since the last WAL segment reached the object store. Last backup: age of the newest barman-cloud base backup. The CloudNativePG dashboard in the links above goes deeper.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_backends_total) / max by (namespace, pod) (cnpg_pg_settings_setting{name="max_connections"})

sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="postgres"} and on (namespace, pod) cnpg_collector_up) / max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{container="postgres",resource="memory"})

panels.title: Postgres connections
panels.description: Backends per instance, by state. Dashed: max_connections.

panels.title: Postgres memory vs limit
panels.description: Working set of the postgres container. Dashed: its memory limit. Reaching the limit gets the instance OOM-killed.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="postgres"} and on (namespace, pod) cnpg_collector_up)
max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{container="postgres",resource="memory"} and on (namespace, pod) cnpg_collector_up)

panels.title: Time since last WAL archived
panels.description: Sawtooth is normal: it resets every time a segment is archived (at least every archive_timeout). A line that keeps climbing means archiving to the object store is stuck, and point-in-time recovery falls behind.

panels.title: Postgres transactions
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks per second across each instance's databases. A spike of rollbacks usually means the app is failing queries.

panels.title: CoreDNS responses by code
panels.description: SERVFAIL means CoreDNS could not reach the upstream resolver; a burst of NXDOMAIN is usually search-path noise.

panels.title: Scrape targets down
panels.description: Targets Prometheus could not scrape on its last attempt. Their metrics on this page are stale or missing.

panels.title: Prometheus storage
panels.description: TSDB blocks plus WAL on disk. Dashed: retentionSize (15 GB), past which Prometheus drops the oldest blocks; the volume is 20 Gi.
